**Finding: compliant (at fallback, with much of preferred also met).**

- **Affiliates** — Section 2.2(a) (p0171) gives Ono the right to sublicense the Array Patents and Know-How to its Affiliates without Array consent (consent is needed only for Third Party Sublicensees/distributors); Section 2.1(b) (p0163) expressly allows Affiliate sublicensing of the Manufacturing licence. Section 2.2(d) requires only delivery of executed sublicences — no more than the fallback's written-notice condition.
- **Successor transfer** — Section 18.9 (p0785) permits assignment without consent to an acquirer of substantially all business or assets, whether by merger, acquisition or otherwise.
- **Not revocable at will** — Array may terminate only for uncured material breach, bankruptcy or Competing Product; on expiry Section 13.1 (p0627) makes the Section 2.1 licences "fully paid-up, irrevocable, perpetual, royalty free ... with sublicensing rights."
- **Noted, not flagged** — contractor coverage is express only for Manufacturing (Third Party manufacturers acting on Ono's behalf); Development/Commercialization sublicences to Third Parties require Array's consent. That is a shortfall against preferred wording only, so no redline was proposed.
